about:
# Soapstone for World of Warcraft

> Leave your mark, literally. Scribble doodles and drop secret messages wherever you go, visible only to players who wander into the area.

Soapstone lets you leave short messages and little drawings at spots in the
world, like the orange soapstone messages in *Dark Souls* or doodles like in 
*Splatoon 3*. A stone stays sealed until someone walks right up to it. Then 
it opens, and they can read what you left there: a warning, a tip, a joke, 
a view worth stopping for.

Your minimap shows stones nearby and pulls you toward the sealed ones, with
a soft sound when one is close.

Made for **WoW Forever** (currently in beta).

**[Get Soapstone on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/soapstone)**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Soapstone needs the Soapstone companion app to share stones.** The
> companion carries your stones to other players and brings theirs to you.
> Without it, nobody else will ever see your stones, and you won't find
> theirs.
> **[Get the companion](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/releases/latest)**
> (Windows; macOS coming soon).

## Screenshots

**Leave a stone:** write a message, or draw one.

  ![The Leave a Soapstone window on Write: "Be wary of GANK!", 16 of 140 letters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Screenshots/write.png)
  ![The Leave a Soapstone window on Draw: a skeleton in a hooded robe holding a steaming mug among flames, captioned ANOTHER DAY. SAME BULLSHIT.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Screenshots/draw.png)

**Find it:** its pin on the minimap, and on the world map with how far away
it is. Open it to read, appraise or disparage it.

  ![A minimap pin's tooltip in The Barrens: "Be wary of GANK!" by Mad Decent, score 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Screenshots/minimap.png)
  ![A world map pin's tooltip: Your soapstone, Mad Decent, 1 hr ago, 3850 yd to the north-west, click to guide me there](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Screenshots/world-map.png)

  ![A stone opened: "Be wary of GANK!" by Mad Decent, with Edit, Appraised and Disparage buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Screenshots/read.png)

## Install

Soapstone has two parts, and **you need both**: the addon, and the
**[Soapstone companion](#sharing-with-other-players)**, a small app that
sits in your system tray and connects you to everyone else. It brings
other players' stones into your world and carries yours into theirs.

1. **Get the addon from
   [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/soapstone).** The
   CurseForge app is the best way: it puts Soapstone in the right folder
   and keeps it up to date along with the rest of your addons.
2. **Get the companion: without it, nobody sees your stones.** Download
   `Soapstone-Companion-vX.Y.Z-setup.exe` from its
   [download page](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/releases/latest)
   and run it. It installs just for your Windows user (no admin prompt)
   and starts with Windows, so it's always ready to share. It leaves the
   CurseForge app's copy of the addon alone unless it carries a newer
   version, and if you skipped step 1, it installs the addon for you.
3. **Restart the game** once so it picks up the new files. A soapstone
   button appears on your minimap.

**Keep the companion running while you play.** It's what shares your
stones with other players and brings theirs to you.

> **Coming soon:** the companion for macOS.

> **Beta.** The companion is new, so expect rough edges. Its installer
> isn't code-signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC":
> choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Each release lists the
> installer's SHA-256 checksum, so you can check your download.

What's new in each version is in the [changelog](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## How to play

- **Leave a stone:** click the soapstone button on your minimap, or type
  `/soap`. Write up to 140 letters, or switch to **Draw** and sketch
  something. Press **Drop Stone** and it's left right where you stand.
- **Find stones:** pins on your minimap point to stones nearby, and you'll
  hear a soft sound when an unread one is close. The world map shows every
  stone you know of and how far away it is.
- **Read a stone:** walk up to it. Within about 40 yards it opens: the
  minimap button glows, and you can click its pin to read it. Once you've
  read a stone, come back any time to read it again.
- **Get directions:** click a stone on the world map to be guided there.
  With [TomTom](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/tomtom) installed you
  get its arrow; otherwise you get the game's own map pin.
- **Appraise or disparage:** praise a stone you liked, or mark one you
  didn't. Appraised pins turn gold. Disparaged ones fade and stop calling
  you over. A stone's score adds up every player's votes, and its pin
  shows how many players have found it.
- **Change your mind:** for 5 minutes after dropping a stone, you can edit
  or delete it from its window.

Each of your characters finds stones for themselves: a stone your main has
read is still sealed for your alts.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/soap` | Leave a stone where you stand |
| `/soap list` | Stones nearby, nearest first |
| `/soap read` | Open the nearest stone you're close enough to read |
| `/soap guide` | Point the way to the nearest sealed stone (`/soap guide off` stops) |
| `/soap companion` | Where to get the Soapstone companion, which shares your stones with other players |
| `/soap sync` | Reload the UI so the companion syncs now (also: shift-click the minimap button) |
| `/soap sound` | Turn the sound cues on or off |
| `/soap button` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/soap help` | Every command |

## Sharing with other players

The **Soapstone companion** is a small app that sits in your system tray
next to WoW and shares stones with everyone through a shared database:
stones other players left show up when you log in, along with their
drawings, and yours reach them the same way. If you don't use the
CurseForge app, it also installs and updates the addon for you (see
[Install](#install)).

It only reads and writes Soapstone's own files, the way the WeakAuras
Companion does, and never touches the game itself. Because WoW only loads
files when you log in or reload, new stones arrive at your next login or
`/reload`. While WoW is running, the companion checks for new stones every
3 minutes. Shift-click the minimap button (or type `/soap sync`) to reload
right away: the companion shares your new stones within seconds, and you
get every stone it has fetched so far.

What the companion sends, and who can see it, is in the
[privacy policy](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/blob/main/PRIVACY.md). To uninstall it, use Windows Settings >
Apps > Soapstone; that also removes it from Windows startup.

## Inspiration

Soapstone grew out of two games. In *Elden Ring* and *Dark Souls*, players
leave messages on the ground for strangers to find and rate. In
*Splatoon 3*, players' drawings pop up around the plaza. Soapstone brings
both to Azeroth.

  ![Elden Ring: a player's message reads "If only I had a giant... but hole...", rated Poor, with 7404 appraisals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Inspiration/elden-ring-message.jpg)
  ![Splatoon 3: a player's drawn post above the plaza stairs reads "BIG. MAN." next to a sketch of a flexing muscleman](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/main/docs/Inspiration/splatoon-3-post.png)

*Left: a message in Elden Ring. Right: a drawn post in Splatoon 3.*

Soapstone is also a spin-off of
[Soapstone](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone), a phone app for
leaving voice messages at real-world places.

Want to build or change Soapstone? See the
[developer notes](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/blob/main/docs/Development.md).

**Privacy policy:** the companion sends the Soapstone server your
characters' names, the stones you leave and change, your appraisals and
reports, and which stones your characters have opened; the installer shows
this before you install. See
the full [privacy policy](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/blob/main/PRIVACY.md). The addon itself sends nothing; all
sharing goes through the companion. (The one exception is an older,
experimental player-to-player network, `/soap net join`, which is off by
default.)

## Support

Soapstone is free. If you enjoy it, you can buy me a coffee:

[![Buy me a coffee](https://img.buymeacoffee.com/button-api/?text=Buy%20me%20a%20coffee&emoji=&slug=georgeplendl&button_colour=FFDD00&font_colour=000000&font_family=Inter&outline_colour=000000&coffee_colour=ffffff)](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/georgeplendl)

releases.name: Soapstone Companion v0.2.3 (beta)
releases.notes:
Soapstone 0.6.0 included, and an installer that tells you what it does.

### New in Soapstone 0.6.0
- **Scores count everyone.** A stone's score now adds up every player's appraisals and disparagements (one per computer), not just your own characters'. Your vote counts straight away, even before the companion has shared it.
- **Found counts.** Hovering a stone on the minimap or world map shows how many players have found it.
- **Get the companion from inside the game.** `/soap companion` shows where to download the companion, so friends who only have the addon can find it. Players without the companion get a reminder when they log in, which they can turn off. You have the companion, so you won't see it.

### Companion
- **Read before you install.** The installer now starts with a page saying what the companion does on your PC, what it sends to the Soapstone server, and who can see it, with a link to the [privacy policy](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).
- **Uninstalling removes it from Windows startup too.**

### Install
1. Download `Soapstone-Companion-v0.2.3-setup.exe` below and run it, or install it over an earlier version. It installs just for your Windows user, with no admin prompt, and updates Soapstone to 0.6.0.
2. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Restart WoW once so it picks up the new files. After that, a `/reload` is enough.

Got Soapstone from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/soapstone)? Keep updating it there. The companion leaves your copy alone unless it carries a newer version.

**Check your download:** the installer's SHA-256 is `deaa6f14832695a6edd92d5e1f3e1be809e83b6a488d4e78ada84db438f98a4d` (in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\Soapstone-Companion-v0.2.3-setup.exe`). `Soapstone-v0.6.0.zip` is `eb5dd93e0e4e1251f474485b27a6f5e94ecdb0a6abd97ce5909fcb2dfc35b761`. Only download Soapstone from this page.

### Beta
Expect rough edges. If something looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/issues).

releases.name: Soapstone Addon v0.6.0
releases.notes:
### Added
- **Scores count everyone.** With the companion, a stone's score now adds
  up every player's appraisals and disparagements (one per computer), not
  just your own characters'. Your vote counts straight away, even before
  the companion has shared it.
- **Found counts.** Hovering a stone on the minimap or world map shows how
  many players have found it.
- **Get the companion from inside the game.** Without the Soapstone
  companion, nobody else sees your stones and you don't find theirs. Type
  `/soap companion` for a window with its download link, ready to copy
  into your browser. Until the companion is set up, it also opens a few
  seconds after you log in (not after a `/reload`); tick **Don't show this
  again** if you'd rather it didn't. Shift-clicking the minimap button
  opens it too, and the button's tooltip now says plainly when your stones
  aren't being shared.

---

**You need the Soapstone companion to share stones.** Without it, nobody else sees your stones and you won't find theirs. [Get the companion](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/releases/latest) (Windows; macOS coming soon).

**Install the addon:** get it on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/soapstone) (the CurseForge app keeps it up to date), or download `Soapstone-v0.6.0.zip` and unzip it into `World of Warcraft\<client>\Interface\AddOns`, so you get `AddOns\Soapstone\Soapstone.toc`. Then restart the game.

releases.name: Soapstone Companion v0.2.2 (beta)
releases.notes:
Safety fixes for the companion and the shared server, and Soapstone 0.5.1 included.

### Fixed
- **Stones can't fake system messages any more.** WoW formatting codes in a stone or a name (colours, links, pictures) are shown as plain text. The shared server now refuses them too.
- **Nobody can take over your stones.** A stone claiming the id of someone else's is refused.
- **Fairer scores.** One computer counts as one appraisal and one find per stone, however many characters it shares as (up to 20).
- **Quieter syncing.** The companion syncs every 3 minutes while WoW is running and every 30 minutes otherwise; a `/reload` or logout still shares your changes within seconds.

The shared server also gained rate limits, a starter word filter, a 12-hour limit on edits, and sanity checks on dates. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for what Soapstone protects and the risks we know about.

### Install
1. Download `Soapstone-Companion-v0.2.2-setup.exe` below and run it, or install it over an earlier version. It installs just for your Windows user, with no admin prompt, and updates Soapstone to 0.5.1.
2. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Restart WoW once so it picks up the new files. After that, a `/reload` is enough.

**Check your download:** the installer's SHA-256 is `d6170b3dea54451f2f5e3d622278f34ba50e3c37976756e35e3ab7f0514b15e7` (in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\Soapstone-Companion-v0.2.2-setup.exe`). `Soapstone-v0.5.1.zip` is `4cbf04d47a424f4d46ab1de20357dc40b7089c9daa7d78c2382227f4aa9b44d0`. Only download Soapstone from this page.

### Beta
Expect rough edges. If something looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/issues).

releases.name: Soapstone Addon v0.5.1
releases.notes:
### Fixed
- **Stones can't carry WoW formatting codes any more.** A stone's words, or
  a player's name, could include codes for colours, links or pictures, and
  the game drew them in tooltips, chat and the stone window, so a stone
  could pass itself off as a system message. They now always show as
  plain text.
- **A stone can't take over another player's stone.** A stone claiming the
  same id as one by someone else is refused, so nobody can replace your
  stones in other players' games.

---

**Install:** download `Soapstone-v0.5.1.zip` and unzip it into `World of Warcraft\<client>\Interface\AddOns`, so you get `AddOns\Soapstone\Soapstone.toc`. Then restart the game.

releases.name: Soapstone Companion v0.2.1 (beta)
releases.notes:
A fix for anyone who used the 0.1.0 preview: your existing stones now upload to the shared server.

### Fixed
- **Stones you left with the 0.1.0 preview now reach the shared server.** The preview talked to a test server on your own PC. Once that server had your stones, Soapstone stopped listing them as waiting, so 0.2.0 never sent them to the shared server. Now, the first time the companion syncs with a server, it sends everything your characters already have: your stones, your appraisals and the stones you've opened. If a daily limit holds some back, it tries again the next day until they're all in.

Everything else is as in [0.2.0](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/releases/tag/companion-v0.2.0): the companion shares stones through the shared server and installs or updates Soapstone (0.5.0 is included).

### Install
1. Download `Soapstone-Companion-v0.2.1-setup.exe` below and run it, or install it over 0.2.0. It installs just for your Windows user, with no admin prompt.
2. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Restart WoW once so it picks up the companion's data. After that, a `/reload` is enough.

**Check your download:** the installer's SHA-256 is `3ccdce5197eab02a57184ac024da066e50aa58628136637acbfc1abef35bc485` (in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\Soapstone-Companion-v0.2.1-setup.exe`). `Soapstone-v0.5.0.zip` is `dad96fb610f6e4894cc6d90fd03d6d1154dd39dacdd649385a0a5a6f299f68a8`. Only download Soapstone from this page.

### Beta
Expect rough edges. If something looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/georgeplendl/Soapstone-WoW/issues).
